Who owns a college athlete's value?――NILと米国大学スポーツの収益革命

2021 NIL freedom and the 2025 House settlement created two different paths for student-athlete compensation. Primary sources show $1.77 billion in university direct payments in 2025–26, separate from reported values of cleared third-party NIL deals. This essay examines fairness, compliance, and practical rights design for Japan.
